rulings: Program charter D7: ordinary first actionable result at most 2 s, declared scale at most 5 s, entire suite at most 300 s, every observed sample; size is telemetry
W3.3 coordinator ruling 5: the D7 bars apply per target, WASM included; a red result is reported and never re-thresholded; the 768 MiB RSS guardrail stays telemetry
W3.3 coordinator ruling 6: a predeclared smaller blocking-case set on hosted runners; fail holds the release; inconclusive is recorded and does not hold the first stable release
authority.amendment: A change to any value in this file needs a new id and a new predeclaration before the next run; measured noise never widens a bar.

protocol.harness: packages/geospec-engine/bench/run.ts schema-v2 campaign (campaign.ts, campaign-run.ts) and campaign-analysis.py, unchanged in method
protocol.timingBoundary: from immediately before the worker process is spawned to the parent's receipt of the first complete canonical claim report; exit and reap are retained separately
protocol.order: fixed alternating AB/BA blocks; no optional stopping, no extension, no replacement of a failed observation
protocol.estimator: geometric mean of paired latency ratios B/A
protocol.bootstrap: whole-pair PCG64 percentile bootstrap, four seed streams, resamples max(1000000, ceil(100 / tailAlpha))
protocol.familyNote: Each unit runs as its own campaign so one censored unit cannot discard the others; every unit declares the whole release family (6 units x 5 hypotheses), so caseAlpha = 0.01 / 30 and tailAlpha = caseAlpha / 2.
protocol.aaRule: each A/A interval (baseline against itself, candidate against itself) contains 1 and lies within [0.95, 1.05]; otherwise the unit is inconclusive
protocol.plantedSlowdownControl: after every A/A pair a third arm reruns route A with the public report delayed by max(8 ms, 0.25 x that pair's A report); the planted/A interval lower bound must exceed 1.05, otherwise the unit is inconclusive
protocol.productRule: non-inferiority: the candidate/baseline interval upper bound is at most productUpperBound and the seed endpoints are stable
protocol.correctness: every timed observation must reproduce the complete expected report vector byte for byte; the expected vector is the untimed preflight of the baseline, admitted only when baseline and candidate preflights are identical and, where an independent authority exists, carry its expected status
protocol.reportDeadline: each timed invocation is stopped at its class budget (D7), so a sample over the bar censors the unit instead of entering the bootstrap

unit.pass: preflight admitted, campaign complete, both A/A intervals pass, both planted controls are detected, and the product rule passes
unit.fail: calibration admitted and the product rule fails (candidate slower beyond the 1.05 non-inferiority bound), or the candidate's preflight contradicts an independent authority
unit.inconclusive: anything else: calibration not admitted, unstable seed endpoints, non-comparable products, an aborted or censored campaign, or missing evidence

release.fail: any blocking unit fails; fail holds the release
release.inconclusive: otherwise; recorded, and it does not hold the first stable release, which has no stable baseline

decision.q7: absolute bars are Q7 rows, reported by packages/geospec-engine/qualification/q7/report.mjs; they never turn a W10 regression decision into fail

wasm.description: Node 24 single-threaded combined Rust/OCCT WASM module

authority.note: The broad generator certifies the 4,096-occurrence input, not an engine verdict; correctness here is identical complete reports across every arm.
The Q7 scale diagnostic of record (4.80-5.17 s native, 7.5-7.8 s ST WASM); no independent verdict authority.
